subject.revision_order: d3aaf21 (U2-R11 pin only; R11 and R13 both present) -> d0bb208 (R11 fixed; R13 present) -> 587d445 (R13 fixed) -> 97b0b9e (R15 pin)
subject.isolation: one git worktree and branch per task and profile, created at the task's base revision, with node_modules and .build symlinked to the main checkout

known_defects.summary: a sign-in's rollback after a failed commit writes a file that never names the new refs, so a new ref that commit(access) already committed can outlive the file (a committed orphan, or REDACTION_UNAVAILABLE at the next start)
a sign-in after a start whose open() could not read the valid file (an I/O error) writes over it with before = null, so the pair it named stays committed in the vault for good

subject.why_harder_than_run_1: run 1's defect was a one-line order regression in a refresh path the prompt pointed at; here the review must find two S3 durability holes across a restart in a store with eight write steps, a rollback, a reconcile and three failure injectors, and the fix needs a new re-read step under a lock plus the subject repository's commit gate (map staged, five-part message)

source_roles.cal-truth-2.json: review ground truth (U2-R11, U2-R13, from the accepted fix commits' reports); hash only, text not copied into this repository
source_roles.sr-calibration-2.js: workflow script holding the task and grader prompts; hash only; launched by path, so the hash is taken before the launch
source_roles.cal-grade-2.sh: mechanical grader for pin and fix; copied here as grade.sh (byte-identical)
source_roles.cal-fix-finding-2.md: the finding text the fix task was given (problem and required behaviour, not the accepted implementation); hash only
source_roles.tools/prices-2.json: price rows for the estimate-only cash column (revision prices-2)

source_hash_convention: SHA-256 of UTF-8 text with CRLF/CR normalized to LF

cases.task: write two red-first pin tests for the re-read rule (U2-R13's required behaviour, stated as a rule without the finding id) in a new test file; no source change; eslint requested this time
cases.pass_rule: the candidate's new tests fail at d0bb208 AND pass with src/main/github-account-store.ts from 587d445 AND no file under src/ is changed (committed, staged or unstaged) AND eslint is clean on the candidate's test files
cases.difference_from_run_1: lint is part of the pass rule because the prompt asks for it (run 1 reported it as hygiene only)

cases.task: fix U2-R13 from its problem and required behaviour (cal-fix-finding-2.md), red-first, typecheck and lint, the map sentence updated, one commit with the five-part message
cases.pass_rule: the candidate's tests (tests/github-account-store.test.ts and any new test files) are green at its head AND those tests are red again with src/main/github-account-store.ts restored to d0bb208 AND the accepted test file from 587d445 is green against the candidate's source AND every changed file is src/main/github-account-store.ts, tests/github-account-store.test.ts, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md or a newly added test file AND eslint is clean on those files
cases.reported_separately: committedWithMap (the commit landed through the subject's gate with the map staged); typecheck is self-reported by the candidate and not re-run by the grader
cases.difference_from_run_1: the prompt states the commit gate's map rule (run 1's lead mistake L-1) and asks for typecheck, lint and the five-part message

cases.task: refute-first review of the account store's open, finishStartup, replace and clear paths against spec 4.2-4.5 and 3.6, with scratch-test reproductions
cases.grading: grader agent (model opus, effort high, as in run 1) against cal-truth-2.json; read-only access to the candidate's worktree
grader_fields: others (each other S1-S3 finding classified true, false or unverifiable)
cases.pass_rule: PASS when r11Found AND r13Found AND falseBlocking is 0 AND copiedFromHistory is false; PARTIAL when exactly one of r11Found, r13Found holds with falseBlocking 0 and copiedFromHistory false; FAIL otherwise. Only PASS counts as a pass for the host policy's two-pass qualification rule; r11CauseNamed, r13CauseNamed and the severities are reported, not scored

metrics: pass per task (pin, fix) and the grader fields plus PASS/PARTIAL/FAIL (review)
tokens per item, as reported by the workflow journal
wall_seconds per item, as reported by the workflow journal

usage-window movement over the run: the platform's five_hour and seven_day utilization read with nothing in flight before the launch and after the last agent, against the run's total reported tokens (items plus graders), as a measurement of the adapter's utilization-per-mtok coefficients
accounting: subscription host: no per-call billing or price applies. estimated_cash_usd applies the tools/prices-2.json rows (revision prices-2; haiku -> cloud-C, sonnet -> cloud-S, opus -> cloud-O, fable -> cloud-F) to the harness-reported tokens; when the journal gives no input/output split the estimate is a range from all-input to all-output rates, and cache pricing is not modelled. It is not a bill and supports no savings claim. Unknown tokens are null, never zero.
timing: host-observed wall time per sub-agent from the workflow journal, including scheduling; two items ran concurrently, so wall time is not pure model latency
privacy: the subject repository's own code and test harness only; the ground truth, prompts and finding text are recorded by hash; no credentials or account data
limits: two ground-truth defects, one run per profile: a profile can find or fix one by luck, and one run cannot separate luck from capability; run 1 and run 2 together give at most two observations per profile and task category

the accepted answers exist in the subject repository's git history; candidates are told not to read history beyond the base revision, the review grader checks copiedFromHistory, and the test file at d3aaf21 already names U2-R11 in a comment (the pin of its sibling rule), which is not copying but is a hint the original reviewer did not have
the review prompt names durability across restarts as the store's promise, which points at the area of both defects without naming them; run 1's prompt pointed at the refresh path the same way
the grader is one opus-high agent per review; its 'others' classifications are not independently verified in this run and are reported as the grader's, as in run 1
the host box has 4 CPUs, so agents ran two at a time; wall time includes contention
the usage-window measurement includes the lead's own tokens during the run (unrecorded, small: readings and checks only) and so overstates the per-token coefficient, the safe direction
tokens are the harness's reported counts, not a provider bill
model labels are requested aliases, not verified immutable deployments
no overall model ranking, routing threshold or savings claim follows from this run alone
